x-e-e4-01.title: Notsi yaAmai nenguva yokutamba yaJisu
x-e-e4-01.goal: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvakati wandei zviri panotsi yaAmai nenguva yakakurudzirwa neshamwari, tsvaga pasingaenderani, uye uti kwete muChirungu uchikurudzira nguva yakasiyana.
x-e-e4-01.material:
'Notsi yakasiiwa naAmai patafura (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Shure kweizvozvo shamwari yake Jisu akatumira meseji. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'

x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Tonga kana 'muganho' wenguva nenguva imwe chete zvichipindirana

x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mitsetse yose yenotsi inopindirana munguva neyakakurudzirwa naJisu (4:15-5:15).

x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Enzanisa kana nguva yaunosvika kumba iri pamberi kana pashure pe 4:15.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Verenga kuti chidzidzo chinotanga nguva ipi uye chinopera nguva ipi, uchichiisa padivi penguva yepaki.

x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Piano class i 4:00-4:30, saka 4:15-4:30 inopindirana, uye kubvisa marara pa 5:00 kuri mukati me 4:15-5:15. Kusvika kumba pa 3:30 nedinner pa 6:30 zviri kunze kwenguva yepaki.

x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora zvirongwa zviviri zvinopindirana zvinobva panotsi nenguva dzazvo, uye pakupedzisira ukurudzire ne 'Can we play at ...?'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakapa here zvikonzero zvose zviviri, piano nokubvisa marara?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakakurudzira here nguva yakasiyana, uye nguva iyoyo haipindirani nezvirongwa zviri panotsi?

x-e-e4-02.title: Sarudza nguva dzokufamba nembwa nedzoruzivo rwepamba
x-e-e4-02.goal: Gadzira zvisanganiswa zvakasiyana zvakati wandei zvenguva yokufamba nenguva yoruzivo rwepamba zvinogutsa mamiriro ose ari panotsi yaBaba.
x-e-e4-02.material:
"Notsi yakasiiwa naBaba (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Pazasi, nyora nguva imwe neimwe se 'maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.'. Semuenzaniso, kana ukatanga pa 4:30, nyora 30, uye kana ukatanga pa 5:15, nyora 75."

x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Iri imamiriro ari pamusoro pokuti basa rinotora nguva yakadini, kwete nguva yokutanga.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Homework i 5:00-6:00 uye kufamba i 5:30-6:00, saka mabasa maviri anopindirana kubva pa 5:30 kusvika pa 6:00. Kufamba kunotanga shure kwe 5:00 uye mabasa ose maviri anopera pamberi pe 6:30, saka mamwe mamiriro anochengetwa.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira zvirongwa 3 zvakasiyana zvinochengeta mamiriro ose ari panotsi. w ndiko kutanga kufamba uye k ndiko kutanga homework (maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.).

x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Mabasa ose maviri anopera pamberi pe 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Kufamba kana homework zvinopera shure kwe 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Kufamba kunofanira kutanga pakati pemaminitsi 60 ne 120 (5:00-6:00), uye homework inofanira kutanga mukati memaminitsi 90 (pasati pa 5:30). Pakati pazvo, zvisanganiswa zvisingapindirani ndizvo mhinduro. Mienzaniso: (kufamba 60, homework 0), (kufamba 90, homework 0), (kufamba 60, homework 90).
